---
title: "attaviz"
subtitle: "Publication-ready charts and maps for Altair"
---

Attaviz provides Altair themes, opinionated chart factories, and choropleth maps
based on the [World Bank Group Data Visualization Style Guide](https://worldbank.github.io/data-visualization-style-guide/).

```python
import pandas as pd
import attaviz

attaviz.enable()

data = pd.DataFrame(
    {"country": ["Indonesia", "Malaysia"], "population": [280, 35]}
)

chart = attaviz.bar(
    data,
    category="country",
    value="population",
    title="Population by country (millions)",
)
```
